name: Label Smoothing
tagline: Cross-entropy with $\varepsilon=0.05$ uniform smoothing of the target distribution during training only; eval reverts to standard CE for comparability.
diff_from_baseline: Szegedy et al., 'Rethinking the Inception Architecture' (2016). Reduces overconfidence by mixing the one-hot target with a uniform distribution; here applied only at training time so eval loss stays comparable.

name: Softcap Cross-Entropy
tagline: Pass logits through a sigmoid-based softcap before cross-entropy to prevent extreme logit magnitudes while preserving rank.
diff_from_baseline: KellerJordan/modded-nanogpt PR #199, inspired by Gemma 2 attention-logit softcapping. Bounded sigmoid cap on logits before cross-entropy.

name: Z-Loss
tagline: Standard cross-entropy plus a small penalty on the squared log-partition $\log Z(x)^2$, which discourages logit magnitudes from drifting.
diff_from_baseline: Chowdhery et al., 'PaLM: Scaling Language Modeling with Pathways' (2022). Stabilizes pretraining by regularizing the log-partition function.
